The perimeter of a square is 20 cm. What is the area of a square which has double the perimeter of the original one?

How many of the following statements are correct?
• A rectangle is always a square.
• A square is not always a rhombus.
• A parallelogram is a type of quadrilateral.
• A quadrilateral cannot be a rhombus and a rectangle at the same time.
• A parallelogram cannot have all its sides equal.

Sixty four athletes compete in groups of four in a 100 m race. The winner of each group proceeds to the next round until we have a winner. How many races will take place in total?

A number A was analyzed into a product of prime factors in the following way:
A = 2 × 3 × 3 × 17
How many are the positive divisors of number A?

11 cent, 19 cent, 30 cent, 31 cent, 50 cent

How many full turns in total will all three pointers of a wall watch cover in a day?
Six squares are in a row. We want to paint 3 of them red and 3 of them green. In how many different ways can we do that if we cannot draw two adjacent squares green?

What must we place in the position of the question mark in order to have a balance?

The graphs below show the monthly billing packages of four mobile phone companies. Which two of the following descriptions do not correspond to any of the monthly billing packages of the four mobile companies?
• Π₁: There is no fixed monthly charge. The charge is proportional to the talk time.
• Π₂: There is no fixed monthly charge. Initially, free talk time is offered. Afterwards, the charge is proportional to the talk time.
• Π₃: There is a fixed monthly charge. Initially, free talk time is offered. Afterwards, the charge is proportional to the talk time.
• Π₄: There is no fixed monthly charge. Initially, the charge is proportional to the talk time. Afterwards, the charge is still proportional to the talk time, but reduced.
• Π₅: There is a fixed monthly charge. Talk time is unlimited.
• Π₆: There is no fixed monthly charge. Initially, the charge is proportional to the talk time. Afterwards, the charge is still proportional to the talk time, but increased.
